description: Cambridge Rocketry Simulator models unguided rocket flights and landing uncertainty. Simon Box and Willem Johannis Eerland provide a Java design interface, C++ flight model and Python visualization, with XML exchanged between components. The model includes six-degree-of-freedom dynamics, parachute descent and Monte Carlo runs for uncertain vehicle and atmospheric conditions. Coverage is the configured launch site, trajectory and flight duration. Results can support related space-infrastructure teaching and launch-area exposure studies. Software access is free, but licence metadata conflict: SourceForge and DataCite state GPL v3, while the inspected Zenodo page and API state GPL v2. A limitation is the legacy release environment and the need to check the applicable source-file licence before redistribution. Predicted landing regions depend on the specified uncertainty model and do not independently establish operational safety. No archive or installer was downloaded and no flight was simulated.
